Grip giving out before your lats and back do is a common one. A few things worth trying: check your grip width—too wide makes it harder for your hands to hold on; most people do better with a shoulder-width or slightly wider grip. Try chalk or liquid grip if your hands are sweaty. And grip endurance itself can be trained—dead hangs and farmer carries build that up between pull-up sessions.

What usually works best is figuring out if it's your forearms or just the skin on your hands slipping. Are you losing your grip part-way through a rep, or is it more a surface friction thing?
